intro: Seven articles published between 2026-04-13 and 2026-10-23 are tagged cryptography. Coverage names CVE-2022-39173 and CVE-2026-8149 among the tracked vulnerabilities. The affected sectors recorded are technology, all, Critical Infrastructure, cybersecurity, and Energy, while the regions cited are Global and India. Across the tagged reporting, the severity mix comprises 3 high, 2 medium, and 1 critical finding. The archive collects ZCyberNews reporting on cryptographic vulnerabilities and related incidents within that period, organised under a single tag for readers following the topic.
